text:
Olivia Park (PM): Morning team — quick AM check. Roadmap items for this sprint: routing UX tweaks, model rollout gating, and private-deploy docs. Drop what you shipped yesterday, any blockers, and any CR pings. I'll summarize for the 11:00 sync.

Maya Patel: Finished embed-cache perf test yesterday — ~12% QPS improvement on the benchmark. Blocker: need a decision on fallback policy for oversized prompts. Do we soft-fallback to a smaller model or throttle? @Olivia Park (PM) :thinking:

Sanjay Rao: Backfilled unit + e2e tests for the canary path. PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/453 — needs one more reviewer from @Leo Chen. No other blockers from my side.

Leo Chen: I can review Sanjay's PR today, aiming to merge before lunch. Also working on autoscale policy tests — hitting infra quota on dev cluster (ticket #789).

Maya Patel: For fallback I'd prefer a soft-fallback to avoid latency spikes, but we should log and surface metrics for every fallback event. If we go that route, spec needs a short section on metrics and SLO impact. @Olivia Park (PM) can you add that to the spec?

Olivia Park (PM): Yep — will add a section to the spec draft: https://docs.internal/redwood/specs/fallbacks (WIP). Quick prioritization question: bundle fallback + embed-cache tuning in this sprint, or split? I'm leaning to bundle if it's unblockable.

Aria Gomez: My vote is bundle only if Maya can deliver the spec + dashboard this week; otherwise split. We shouldn't let Dedicated launch depend on this.

deploy-bot: canary terraform apply succeeded on staging — no errors detected. Plan: promote to canary at 14:00 if no regressions :white_check_mark:

Sanjay Rao: Noted. @Maya Patel if you make the metrics dashboard I can wire alarm hooks and alerting.

Maya Patel: I'll create a lightweight dashboard by EOD and post the link here.

Olivia Park (PM): One more ask: @Leo Chen can you review the small routing UX PR linked in the doc? It's primarily CSS + one conditional behavior change.

Leo Chen: Will review after Sanjay's PR.

Olivia Park (PM): Thanks everyone. I'll update the roadmap doc and ping leadership after the 11:00 sync. If anything pops up urgent, DM me.
